message.airswap.swapped: Air Swap: mace in hotbar slot %s
config.airswap.title: Air Swap Settings
config.airswap.warning: Combat automation may violate server rules. Use only where explicitly permitted. Damage is decided by the server.
config.airswap.enabled.tooltip: Master switch, shared with the toggle keybind. New configurations start enabled. Combat automation may be prohibited on public servers.
config.airswap.swap_back.tooltip: Return to the original sword after attacking. Manual slot changes or opening a screen cancel a pending return.
config.airswap.swap_back_delay.tooltip: Wait 0–10 client ticks before returning to the sword. Zero restores immediately after the attack call. One is the default. Server timing may differ.
config.airswap.players_only.tooltip: Only attacks against players trigger a swap. Disable to allow attacks against other entities too.
config.airswap.minimum_fall_distance.too: Require at least this much accumulated fall distance. Zero also allows airborne attacks while rising. Vanilla mace smash eligibility is still checked by the server.
config.airswap.all_swords.tooltip: Accept every item in the minecraft:swords tag, including correctly tagged modded swords. Disable to use the allowed-swords list instead.
config.airswap.allowed_swords.tooltip: Used when all swords is disabled. Example: minecraft:diamond_sword, minecraft:netherite_sword. Entries must still be in the swords tag. Invalid IDs are ignored; an empty list permits no swords.
config.airswap.only_hotbar: Only swap if mace is in hotbar
config.airswap.only_hotbar.tooltip: Use the first mace in hotbar slots 1–9. If disabled and none is there, swap the first main-inventory mace into the sword slot using a normal inventory SWAP click. With swap-back enabled, that inventory exchange is reversed afterward if safe. Offhand is never searched.
config.airswap.show_swap_message.tooltip: Display a short action-bar message identifying the selected mace slot. Toggle-key messages always display.
config.airswap.disable_when_sneaking.too: Do not trigger a new swap while sneaking. Does not cancel the underlying attack.
config.airswap.cooldown_ticks.tooltip: Minimum 0–20 client ticks between successful swaps. This does not change vanilla attack cooldown or bypass server checks.
config.airswap.reset.tooltip: Immediately restore and save all Air Swap settings, then refresh this screen. Does not change the keybind in Minecraft Controls.
